nodes.rationale: MuJoCo joint ranges are compliant, ankles exceed hard stops and knees hit 140% velocity limit; torque ceiling hit routinely during catches - main reason for a QP between policy and motors.

nodes.norm_label: tutorial: adapting the template to a unitree g1

nodes.label: Rename exported integration points (NewRLQPController -> G1RLQPController)
nodes.rationale: All integration points (class/files, constructor, states, CMake targets, config, GUI/logger prefixes, tests) must be renamed consistently.

nodes.label: TODO(robot) markers
nodes.rationale: Template tags every robot-specific decision as TODO(robot) so grep finds what remains to adapt.

nodes.label: General robot adaptation procedure
nodes.rationale: Generalizes the G1 tutorial: fork/rename, resolve every TODO(robot), add policies.

nodes.label: FallSwitch (src/policy/FallSwitch.cpp)
nodes.rationale: Runs on 20 ms policy tick before action choice; computes 37 physics_features, 5-frame window; zero command and stopped gait clock during automatic switch.

nodes.label: estimator.onnx switch-failure estimator
nodes.rationale: Bound to the exact weak/recovery_v0 pair; output 5 logits for horizons [0,5,10,20,40], switch on the last (p>0.825).

nodes.label: limit_kernel.json ellipsoid (Mahalanobis hand-back)
nodes.rationale: Hand-back cuts walking time lost from 38.6% to 15.1% without worsening fall rate.

nodes.label: recovery_v0.onnx catch controller
nodes.rationale: A walking policy trained with small pushes, not a dedicated catch controller; recovers ~1.0 m/s pushes reliably.

nodes.label: release_dwell_steps
nodes.rationale: Set in config because bundle README says 25 but limit_kernel.json says 10.

nodes.label: actions term = raw action of last actor
nodes.norm_label: actions term = raw action of last actor

nodes.label: Shared 98-wide observation layout
nodes.rationale: Walking policy trained with Unitree's layout so both policies are interchangeable at handover; one vector per step.

nodes.label: Command zero at the handover
nodes.rationale: Estimator labels assume zero twist after switch; phase forced to (0,0) when |command|<0.1 so gait clock stops.

nodes.label: Base template (new-rl-qp-controller)
nodes.rationale: Maintained as a reusable robot-agnostic template; the tutorial adapts it to a specific robot.

nodes.label: CBF-QP gains (zeta/lambda jointLimit, selfCollision)
nodes.rationale: Default task stack is a starting point; G1 keeps template defaults, which should be reviewed per robot.

nodes.label: ExternalForcesObserver
nodes.rationale: MomentumObserver for robots without F/T sensors (H1, G1); ForceSensorBased for HRP5P.

nodes.label: Tilt observer
nodes.rationale: Requires controller-side registration of anchorFrameFunction in the datastore before the observer is created; listing it in ObserverPipelines is not enough.

nodes.label: Initial state before RL
nodes.rationale: Some robots need stabilization, estimator init or operator validation before RL; HRP5P uses it, G1/H1 start directly in RL.

nodes.label: Architecture
nodes.rationale: mc_rtc integration and policy runtime kept as separate layers connected through NewRLQPController.

nodes.label: Training conventions
nodes.rationale: A convention changes representation, not semantics; it is optional and exists to keep policy configs short.

nodes.label: Two-layer design: mc_rtc integration + policy runtime
nodes.norm_label: two-layer design: mc_rtc integration + policy runtime

nodes.label: G1RLQPController::createContactAnchor
nodes.rationale: No foot F/T sensors, so external knee torque from the momentum observer proxies weight distribution; anchor interpolates between feet, 0.02 threshold falls back to 50/50.

nodes.label: ExternalForcesObserver (MomentumObserver)
nodes.rationale: G1 has no force/torque sensors, so external joint torques are estimated with a momentum observer.

nodes.label: Tilt observer
nodes.rationale: Estimates floating-base pose/velocity from IMU plus an anchor frame provided by a C++ callback.

nodes.label: anchorFrameFunction datastore callback
nodes.rationale: Anchor is robot-specific so the controller must provide it via the mc_rtc datastore key referenced in config.

nodes.label: last_action named actions
nodes.rationale: name: actions matches ONNX metadata so observation order cross-check passes.

nodes.label: phase observation (cos_first false, command_deadzone 0.1)
nodes.rationale: Settled from mjlab observations.py: sine first, phase zeroed when command norm < 0.1; omitting would show a gait phase while standing, never seen in training.

nodes.label: ONNX metadata section
nodes.rationale: Controller refuses to load if metadata joint order differs from convention's all group.

nodes.label: Observation order = training order (YAML concatenation)
nodes.rationale: Final policy input is concatenated in YAML order, so it must reproduce deploy.yaml order.

nodes.label: 'all' joint group
nodes.rationale: The only thing the controller needs; comes from ONNX joint_names metadata first, else the convention's all group; both must be identical if present.

nodes.label: ONNX metadata
nodes.rationale: Exporters like mjlab store joint_names, default_joint_pos, action_scale, stiffness, damping; ONNX wins for q0/scale, policy.yaml wins for kp/kd.

nodes.label: joint_groups.all (29-joint training order)
nodes.rationale: Must match ONNX training/export order exactly; optional if ONNX metadata stores joint_names.
